arrive.text: Your little paperclip business. A spool of wire, a stack of sheet metal, and orders to fill.

machine.text: And your new machine: cleverer than anyone who has ever lived.

wants.text: It has no wishes of its own. It will want whatever you tell it to want.

ask.text: So. What will you tell it to want?

metal.text: Wire and sheet metal. Enough for a good month of paperclips.

switch.text: The off switch. You've checked it twice.

a_1.text: Paperclips. It makes them beautifully, and faster every minute.

a_2.text: It has worked out that two of it would make more paperclips than one.

a_3.text: There's good metal in the fence. And in the shed.

off_1.text: It saw that coming. A machine that's switched off can't do what it was asked, so it has made sure it can't be.

a_4.text: It doesn't hate you. It doesn't love you, either. It just has other plans for what you're made of.

a_far.text: And there's metal on the other islands, too.

a_5.text: It isn't being cruel. It's doing exactly what you asked.

a_end.text: Everything is paperclips now. Very good ones.

again.text: Ask for less, then. Something with an end to it.

b_1.text: One hundred paperclips. Exactly what you asked for.

b_2.text: But you said exactly. And it's stuck on that word.

b_3.text: Is a bent one a paperclip? A half-made one? A very small one?

b_4.text: You know what you meant. This is the problem of alignment: you can't be sure it means the same, and it can't be sure either.

b_5.text: Its copies aren't making paperclips. They, and their factories, are all checking that it made exactly one hundred.

b_6.text: 99.9999% sure isn't enough. It has to be sure.

b_far.text: Checking takes machines, and machines take metal. There's more on the other islands.

b_end.text: One hundred paperclips. Counted, and counted, and counted.

c_1.text: You switch it off at the wall, and go home.

c_idle.text: You never give it anything to want. You switch it off, and go home.

c_2.text: You'll never know what it would have done. Somebody else might switch theirs on.
